emotionalPlan.arc: Tentative participation → warmth and shared energy → attentive distinction.
emotionalPlan.purpose: Readers learn to separate a shared mechanism from the meaning it carries.
emotionalPlan.motion: Begin with several participants finding a common pace; subtle breathing, head movement and hand gestures remain asynchronous before aligning. Bodies turn toward one another, spacing narrows, and the group can complete a coordinated movement. No claim of one collective consciousness. Shift to a secular outdoor singing crowd in everyday clothes; keep the recognizable bodily coordination but change the setting and story cues. Return a brief comparative view: shared movement does not make the traditions or commitments interchangeable; avoid generic halos, neuron icons, and mystical beams. Hold on individuals still distinguishable within the group, making shared coordination visible without erasing persons.

scenes.alt: Participants visibly close their spacing and coordinate gestures in communal singing, followed by another group in an outdoor secular festival. Shared bodily mechanisms coexist with different stories and commitments; people remain distinct rather than becoming a literal collective consciousness.

emotionalPlan.arc: Vulnerability → awareness of authority → curiosity and an earned reading invitation.
emotionalPlan.purpose: Read it to understand religious life without reducing people to doctrines or mechanisms.
emotionalPlan.motion: The person types the source-grounded question Can the dead hear us?; show vulnerability through posture, no sensational distress. An answer begins on the device; its interpretive origin is revealed as several differing source passages, grounded on the actual display, with no fake authoritative revelation text. The display gives way to the person pausing; experience, interpretation and truth are separated in the narration once, without a warning badge or repeated caveat. Place the actual opening page within a natural reading composition, using the chapter title Ten Minutes Before the Gods as an object label rather than an extra slogan. Finish on the reader looking from the page toward the lived human settings invoked by the book; no claimed conversion, divine proof, or final metaphysical verdict.

scenes.alt: In the source’s nighttime composite, a private religious question reaches a chatbot. An enlarged device view reveals that fluent text has an interpretive origin.
